title: Integrative Modeling Identifies a Dual-Function Helix in Full-Length MDM2, Providing Novel Mechanistic Insights.
authors: Chaudhary, Hariom; Pandey, Archna; Chowhan, Rimpy Kaur
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold集成建模与全原子MD模拟构建全长MDM2动态模型，揭示其自抑制螺旋调控p53结合口袋的机制，属于蛋白质-DNA/蛋白互作动态机制研究，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: The E3 ubiquitin ligase MDM2, an important oncogene, is a central negative regulator of p53, yet its extensive intrinsically disordered regions have hindered structural characterization of the full-length protein. Here, we integrate AlphaFold ensemble modeling to sample the conformational landscape with all-atom molecular dynamics simulations to characterize structural stability and construct a comprehensive, dynamic model of full-length MDM2. Our analysis identifies a previously uncharacterized autoinhibitory helix (upstream of the central acidic domain) in MDM2 that dynamically masks the N-terminal p53-binding pocket. The dynamic ensembles reveal a multistep unmasking pathway in which the helix pivots away to expose the buried p53-binding pocket. This is followed by a stabilization mechanism whereby, in the bound complex, the same helix repositions to act as an adaptive clamp, anchoring the docked p53. Our study indicates this dynamic gating apparatus to be evolutionarily conserved among MDM2 homologues. These findings provide an atomic-level framework for understanding how MDM2's intrinsic dynamics regulate p53 recognition and suggest new avenues for therapeutic targeting of the p53-MDM2 axis.
abstract_zh: E3泛素连接酶MDM2作为一种重要的癌基因，是p53的关键负调控因子，然而其广泛的内在无序区域阻碍了全长蛋白质的结构表征。在此，我们整合AlphaFold集成建模以采样构象景观，并结合全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来表征结构稳定性，构建全长MDM2的综合动态模型。我们的分析识别出MDM2中一个此前未被表征的自抑制螺旋（位于中央酸性结构域上游），该螺旋动态掩蔽N端p53结合口袋。动态集成揭示了一条多步骤的去掩蔽途径，其中螺旋枢转离开以暴露埋藏的p53结合口袋。随后是一种稳定机制，在结合复合物中，同一螺旋重新定位，充当适应性夹钳，锚定对接的p53。我们的研究表明，这一动态门控装置在MDM2同源物中进化上保守。这些发现为理解MDM2的内在动态如何调控p53识别提供了原子级框架，并为p53-MDM2轴的靶向治疗开辟了新途径。
